connections.conditions: Exile remains in the qualifying system through the end-of-combat window; the destroyer must survive its own combat.
Destroyers explore empty systems while establishing breach access; value depends on available frontier targets.
Upgrade extends the breach placement reach; active/inactive side choice depends on destination and route.
Quietus suppresses abilities only while it is in a system with an active breach.
Swap can redeploy a carrier and its carried units; preserve enough ships and planetary defense.
A tactical action and active breach are required to commit a mech remotely.
Sling Relay can build and reposition an additional carrier when the primary or resources support it.
A prepared breach route and the required Mecatol presence make the Imperial play available; scoring still depends on the objective and timing.
